$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file against.

style.description: The registry style the items are built in. Frontic UI has one: bare.

typescript.description: Install items as TypeScript. Off, `add` strips the types and writes .js files.

css.description: The global stylesheet that imports Tailwind. `init` adds the frontic.css import to it, and `build` writes frontic.css beside it.

tailwind.description: Where Tailwind comes into the project.

iconLibrary.description: The icon set `add` rewrites the items’ icons to.

components.description: Where `add` installs sections and templates, and ui items unless `aliases.ui` is set.

ui.description: Where `add` installs ui items; the `ui` folder under `aliases.components` when not set.

lib.description: Where `add` installs lib items, the shared code items import; `@/lib` when not set.

composables.description: Where `add` installs composable items; `@/composables` when not set.

aliases.description: Import paths, resolved through tsconfig, that decide where `add` writes items.

library.description: The folder that holds brand.json, DESIGN.md and recipes/, the shared recipes; each component's own recipes sit in its manifest beside its files.

check.description: What `npx @frontic/ui check` holds the project to.

contrast.description: The WCAG level for colour contrast. AA holds text to 4.5:1 and large text to 3:1; AAA to 7:1 and 4.5:1. Icons and the focus ring need 3:1 under both.

rules.description: How each kind of finding counts: `error` fails `check`, `warn` reports it, `off` skips it.

drift.description: A class the brand’s theme does not define, or a `<script>` that does not parse. Can be `warn`, never `off`.

raw-text.description: Text written into an installed item instead of passed in as a prop or a slot.

contrast.description: A recipe colour or a brand token pair below the contrast level.

missing-token.description: A recipe reference to a token brand.json does not define.

axis-collision.description: Two values of different axes that set one property to different values with no `with` pair between them, so the later axis wins by order.
